mechanism.claim: An unusually active completed day in the Binance BTCUSDT premium index indicates sustained derivatives repricing rather than a quiet spot drift. When the same completed BTC day also has elevated realized variation, its direction should relay for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed prior UTC-day BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: PVIAR used signed first-half premium displacement, same-sign second-half acceleration, joint BVOL/DVOL expansion, and a six-hour premium-direction trade. PPCSR used a persistent premium-sign zero crossing. HVPASR uses the unsigned total variation of all 1,440 premium closes over a full day, takes direction only from BTC, and uses neither implied-volatility feed nor premium polarity. It reuses no prior event set or control.
mechanism.why_not_daily_price_momentum_repair: HVPASR has no candle close-location, range breakout, day-of-week, or scheduled trend rule; the external premium-activity upper tail is mandatory.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: both premium total variation and BTC realized variation must lie in causal upper tails
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one daily premium-activity-conditioned 00:05 UTC clock is absent from Gross9

features.premium_path: 1,440 exact unique bars_binance_premium BTCUSDT 1m closes; all finite; premium may cross or equal zero
features.premium_total_variation: sum(abs(close[i]-close[i-1])) for the 1,439 within-day adjacent close pairs; strict positive
features.btc_path: 288 exact unique completed BTCUSDT 5m OHLC bars covering the same UTC day; all finite, positive, and coherent
features.btc_return: log(last 5m close / first 5m open); strict nonzero
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum of squared log(close/open)) over the 288 completed bars); strict positive
features.causal_ranks: strict-prior midranks over at most 270 earlier source-valid days, minimum 180; current day excluded
features.availability: D 00:00 UTC after both exact source paths complete

clock.decision: exact D 00:00 UTC after the prior UTC day is complete
clock.side: strict sign of prior-day BTC return
clock.reservation: fixed daily opportunities are nonoverlapping; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_bvol_dvol_rv20: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty; RV20 q90 only after all economic stages pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.btc: hash-bound completed BTCUSDT 5m cache through 2026-06-01 plus read-only Postgres completed extension through 2026-08-01
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no day, path, rank, side, hold, timing, subset, threshold, or control repair.
